vulnerability.name: USN-5026-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5026-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in QPDF. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM. Original advisory details:   It was discovered that QPDF incorrectly handled certain malformed PDF  files. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause QPDF to consume  resources, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2018-18020)   It was discovered that QPDF incorrectly handled certain malformed PDF  files. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause QPDF to crash,  resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.  (CVE-2021-36978)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in QPDF. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
